chapters.label: The goal, live
chapters.text: Berlin, the German Cup final, Bayern against Stuttgart. A free kick, then the ball finds Michael Olise on the right. He curls a cross... Harry Kane heads it in!

chapters.label: Watch Olise
chapters.text: Watch Olise again. He loves his stronger left foot. He opens his body and curls it behind the defenders, onto Kane's head.

chapters.label: Behind the goal
chapters.text: From behind the goal: Kane rises and heads it in from close range. His eighth cup goal!

chapters.label: Your turn
chapters.text: Your turn! Know your stronger foot. Get it on the ball, look up, and curl your pass into your teammate's path!
